overall_summary: Deduplicated analysis of FACTVERSE YouTube Shorts performance reveals an overwhelming preference for extreme cosmic and planetary 'What If' scenarios and bizarre physical anomalies. Content focused on speculative planetary environments (e.g., liquid diamond planets, burning ice worlds, dark planets) and extreme cosmic phenomena generates significantly higher views-per-day and engagement (likes-per-view) compared to general psychological tricks or standard biological facts. Recent publications from late September/early October dominate top-tier performance metrics, indicating strong algorithmic favorability toward immersive, high-stakes curiosity loops.

winning_patterns.pattern: Speculative Planetary 'What If' / Extreme Environment Scenarios
winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'What If You Fell Into a Liquid Diamond Planet?' (IYuce8vaU3Y) and 'What If You Fell Into the Planet of Burning Ice?' (8KEl0_pJ_68) achieved massive view counts (approx. 1,000 views) and strong engagement (up to 38 likes) within a short timeframe.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on hypothetical space exploration and extreme planet survival scenarios using high-stakes spatial stakes.

winning_patterns.pattern: Bizarre Cosmic Extreme Anomalies with Visual Emitters
winning_patterns.evidence: Titles detailing extreme planetary states like 'The Planet Darker Than Coal: TrES-2b' (v1rrcZLdp4U) and 'This Planet Rains Supersonic Rubies!' (QXuqYERlqSo) outperformed standard space facts, driving over 700 to 1,000+ views.
winning_patterns.action: Continue sourcing niche, lesser-known exoplanets with extreme, counter-intuitive weather or optical properties.

weak_patterns.evidence: Topics regarding memory creation or song loops (e.g., 'Your Brain Can Create Fake Memories' 2fqaGqfsR4A, Jc04LVKNd2s) stagnated below 20-50 views with near-zero engagement.
weak_patterns.action: Deprioritize straightforward psychological tips unless paired with a high-concept cinematic or shocking experimental hook.

weak_patterns.pattern: Low-Stakes Animal Trivia Without Existential Threat
weak_patterns.evidence: Standard animal facts (e.g., octopus hearts, eternal life) received lower velocity compared to planetary cataclysms.
weak_patterns.action: Shift animal content toward cinematic animal survival or extreme prehistoric context rather than simple biology trivia.

Must use a fresh visual color palette focusing on absolute void and cryogenic luminescence.
